pois.label: 薄膜隧道（25 kPa 作物舱）
pois.detail: 四条 18 m 薄膜隧道,是穹顶温室的「产能版」:人不常驻,压力砍到 25 kPa 富 CO₂——作物不在乎低压,只在乎 CO₂ 分压和水。压力减半,膜的环向张力、泄漏率、锚固负荷全部跟着减半。进出走东端服务舱门,日常作业由机械臂和轨道喷灌完成。
pois.detail_en: Four 18 m film tunnels - the production version of the showcase dome: rarely occupied, so pressure drops to 25 kPa of CO2-rich air. Crops do not mind low pressure; they care about CO2 partial pressure and water. Halving the pressure halves hoop tension, leak rate, and anchor load together. Entry is through the east service door; daily work belongs to rail sprayers and arms.
pois.sim: 结构账:25 kPa × 2.75 m 半径 → 膜环向张力 69 kN/m,叠层膜 ~1.5 mm 够用;若按穹顶的 55 kPa 建,膜厚、压载、锚固全部翻倍。「人不进去」这一个决定,把每平米种植面的结构质量砍了一半。
pois.sim_en: Structural ledger: 25 kPa at 2.75 m radius gives 69 kN/m of hoop tension - a ~1.5 mm laminate suffices. Built at the dome's 55 kPa, film, ballast, and anchors all double. The single decision that humans stay out cuts structural mass per growing square metre in half.
pois.physics: 生物的压力需求分层:人要 ~50 kPa 以上和氧分压,植物只要 ~10 kPa 以上加足量 CO₂ 与水汽。把「人的建筑」和「作物的建筑」分开造,是火星农业的第一条工程学。
pois.physics_en: Pressure requirements are tiered: humans need ~50 kPa and oxygen partial pressure, plants manage above ~10 kPa given CO2 and humidity. Building for crops separately from building for people is the first engineering rule of Martian agriculture.

pois.label: LED 补光（为什么是粉紫色）
pois.detail: 每条隧道拱内两条补光带,夜里把整排膜点成粉紫色——城里第二亮的夜景,和穹顶的暖光灯笼相映。粉紫不是审美:LED 只发红蓝双峰,正对叶绿素的两个吸收峰;绿色被叶子反射掉,所以省掉不发。
pois.detail_en: Two light bars ride each tunnel's crown, washing the whole row pink after dark - the city's second night-glow after the dome's warm lantern. The pink is not aesthetic: the LEDs emit only red and blue peaks, matched to chlorophyll's two absorption bands; green would just bounce off the leaves, so it is simply not emitted.

specs.光谱: 红 660 nm + 蓝 450 nm 双峰

pois.sim: 光账(与穹顶同一本):Jezero 晴日 ~3.0 kWh/m²/日,尘暴 τ>3 时直射 <25%——补光负荷早写进电网账。双峰 LED 把「电→可用光合光子」的转换效率比全谱白光提高约三成,尘暴季这三成就是产量。
pois.sim_en: Light ledger (same book as the dome): clear Jezero days deliver ~3.0 kWh/m2, and dust storms at tau > 3 cut direct sun below 25% - the LED load is pre-booked on the grid. Dual-peak LEDs convert electricity to usable photosynthetic photons ~30% better than white light, and in storm season that 30% is the harvest.
pois.physics: 植物是光谱挑食者:光合作用记的是光子数不是能量数,且只认叶绿素吸收带里的光子。给植物「人眼舒服的白光」是浪费——粉紫色是按收据付款的颜色。
pois.physics_en: Plants are spectral picky eaters: photosynthesis counts photons, not joules, and only photons inside the chlorophyll bands. White light comfortable to human eyes is waste - pink is the color of paying exactly what the receipt says.

pois.label: 集水总管（Rodwell 水线支路）
pois.detail: 西端一条蓝色总管带四个支阀,一管分四路进隧道——上游顺着城里的架空水线(pipe-h2o)接 Rodwell 井,与穹顶温室同一条母管。泵撬把压力顶到滴灌需要的 3 bar。
pois.detail_en: A blue header with four branch valves runs the west end, feeding all tunnels from one pipe - upstream it follows the city's elevated water rack (pipe-h2o) back to the Rodwell well, the same main that serves the dome. The pump skid lifts pressure to the 3 bar drip irrigation wants.
pois.sim: 水账:四条隧道苗床 ~170 m²,净耗 0.6 L/m²/日 ≈ 100 L/日;加上穹顶的 190 L/日,整个农业口不到 300 L/日——对 669 sol 井寿命的日采能力仍是零头。膜内冷凝回收在这里同样成立:隧道是更小号的被动蒸馏器。
pois.sim_en: Water ledger: ~170 m2 of beds across four tunnels net ~100 L/day; with the dome's 190 that puts all of agriculture under 300 L/day - still small change against the 669-sol well's daily draw. Skin condensation recovery works here too: each tunnel is a smaller passive still.
pois.physics: 农业水在闭环里几乎不「消耗」,只循环:蒸腾→膜面冷凝→回槽。真正离场的水只有两笔——收成里的含水,和膜的渗漏。管径按后者的补给算,不按蒸腾算。
pois.physics_en: In a closed loop, agricultural water barely gets consumed - it circulates: transpiration, skin condensation, gutter return. Only two entries ever leave the books: water inside the harvest, and film leakage. The pipe is sized for those, not for transpiration.

pois.label: 设备棚（村子的餐桌账）
pois.detail: 东端设备棚:配电、营养液罐 ×2、控制柜。这排隧道和掩土村是同一期工程——28~32 床位落成,鲜食供应就得跟上。生产排 + 穹顶合计 ~490 m² 种植面,是全城鲜食蔬果的主力。
pois.detail_en: The east-end shed holds power distribution, two nutrient tanks, and controls. This row and the earth-sheltered village are one construction phase: 28-32 berths landing meant fresh food had to follow. Row plus dome total ~490 m2 of beds - the city's fresh-produce mainstay.

specs.定位: 鲜食蔬果主力(主粮仍靠进口)

pois.sim: 餐桌账:全卡路里自给约需 40~50 m²/人——490 m² 只够 10~12 人全口粮,但按「鲜食蔬果配额」记账可以覆盖全城常驻人口。所以策略是:热量密度高的主粮走集装箱进口,新鲜度贵的蔬果本地种——质量账和口味账各记各的。
pois.sim_en: Dinner-table ledger: full caloric self-sufficiency runs 40-50 m2 per person - 490 m2 feeds only 10-12 outright, yet covers the whole resident population's fresh-produce ration. Hence the strategy: calorie-dense staples arrive by container, freshness-priced produce grows locally - the mass ledger and the taste ledger are kept separately.
pois.physics: 运输农业的分界线是「单位质量的保质期」:干粮 26 个月航程无损,叶菜 26 天都撑不住。火星农业最先本地化的永远是最不耐运的部分——这排隧道种的就是集装箱运不了的东西。
pois.physics_en: The dividing line in transported agriculture is shelf life per kilogram: dry staples survive the 26-month pipeline untouched, leafy greens cannot survive 26 days. Martian farming localizes the least shippable goods first - these tunnels grow exactly what a container cannot carry.
